## Histopathology Thyroid Cancer Detection Using YOLO

**Digital & Data Studies Group Project, Binghamton University** \| [Group project](https://github.com/Zihan-Hei/Histopathology-Thyroid-Cancer-Detection-A-Triple-Class-YOLO26-Approach)\
**January 2026–Present**

- Develop a YOLO26-based deep-learning workflow for thyroid cancer, abnormal, and normal histopathology tissue detection, including model training, evaluation, and error analysis.
- Evaluate model performance through Type I (false positive) and Type II (false negative) error analysis and interpret confusion matrices for class imbalance and dataset representativeness.
- Visualize and document model performance and limitations for potential pre-screening
  applications (manuscript in preparation)

## Deep Reinforcement Learning in Board Games

**Digital & Data Studies Group Project, Binghamton University** \| [Group project](https://github.com/Zihan-Hei/Learning-to-Win-Deep-Reinforcement-Learning-DRL-in-Board-Games)\
**September 2025–December 2025**

- Implemented deep reinforcement-learning agents in PyTorch to play Tic-Tac-Toe and Connect Four through self-play.
- Designed neural networks mapping board states to action values.
- Visualized training performance using Matplotlib.
